t: A computer built into a keyboard with 8GB of RAM and a GPIO header.
steps: Get the Raspberry Pi 500 or the Desktop Kit from a Raspberry Pi reseller.
Check the current price on the product page.
Check that each room has an HDMI monitor.
Connect the monitor, mouse, and power supply.
Boot the unit, which has Raspberry Pi OS preloaded.
Set a strong password for the user account during setup.
Run a first Python script to test the board.
